name: Lab-Rat-ory
from: Escape Room (test subject): a lab rat escapes through four levels that grow more realistic; it was all another test.
hook: You are a lab rat. The key in your cage was not an accident.
pitch: Four levels, each sharper than the last: from 8-bit to near-real. Break out of the cage, cross the maze, the workbench, the room with the humans. Each level hides a clue that the escape is planned. The last image is the cage, at full resolution.
build_check: Yes: one level per member; shared controls and palette first.
scope: One level per member is a good split. Agree the rat’s controls and the palette before splitting up.

brief.goal: Escape through four levels: cage, maze, workbench, the room with the humans.
brief.fail: Caught or trapped: restart the level.
brief.ending: The twist: the escape was another test. The last image is the cage, at full resolution.
brief.theme: A subject trained to think it is choosing. The rising resolution shows how much more the rat can see, and how little it changes.
brief.look: Red near-monochrome pixel art; each level a step up in resolution, from 8-bit to near-realistic.

prov.bug: The rat found the key by accident!
prov.nit: Was it an accident? Plant one clue per level that it was not.

refs_lit: Lab rats who escape the institute, made smarter by the experiments. The classic version of your story.
Your own reference: horror from a tiny window and a little information.
A short game whose ending changes who was in control the whole time.
omni_gameplay_prompt: Crimson monochrome top-down stealth-puzzle escape game (#1a0606, #ff6a5a, #ffd6cf) that shifts visual fidelity mid-run. Steady overhead camera following a small white-pink lab rat sneaking out of a chunky 8-bit red pixel wire cage with a gleaming key, scurrying through a lab maze where the tiles seamlessly sharpen into detailed high-resolution workbench instruments, scalpels, and the looming shadow of an observing scientist's hand. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no HUD text. Use the reference image for maze layout and red monochrome palette. Sound design: tiny claws skittering, metallic key clink, tense heartbeat pulse. No dialogue.
